# Bloom & Budget

> A no-shame money blog for young women starting their first job in the United States. Every post is free to read, written in plain language, priced in USD, and focused on one narrow niche: budgeting a first salary, building savings, avoiding expensive mistakes, and the career moves that pay for all of it.

Author: Emma Jane. Contact: nsumair006@gmail.com. Educational content only, not financial advice.

## Posts

- [How to Budget Your First Salary (Without Living Like a Monk)](https://bloomandbudget.vercel.app/posts/budget-first-salary): The four walls, the 50/30/20 split, the three-account trick, and a fully worked $48,000 example.
- [10 Money Mistakes Every Fresh Grad Makes (So You Can Skip Them)](https://bloomandbudget.vercel.app/posts/money-mistakes): The ten most common and most expensive first-year money mistakes, each with a cheap fix.
- [Your Emergency Fund on an Entry-Level Salary: The Realistic Guide](https://bloomandbudget.vercel.app/posts/emergency-fund): Why $500 comes before three months, where to keep the money, and how to fund it on a small salary.
- [Your First Credit Card: What Builds a Score (and Wrecks It)](https://bloomandbudget.vercel.app/posts/first-credit-card-build-credit): How a FICO score is calculated, which first card to get, the four habits that build credit, and what ruins it.
- [The Benefits Form You Fill In During Week One](https://bloomandbudget.vercel.app/posts/first-job-benefits-enrollment): Premium, deductible, HSA, vesting and match translated, plus how to choose between two health plans and what to skip.
- [How to Ask for More on Your First Offer](https://bloomandbudget.vercel.app/posts/negotiate-first-job-offer): When to ask, what to say, which parts of an offer actually move, and what to do when the answer is no.
- [Why Is It So Hard to Get an IT Job Right Now? (The Honest Answer)](https://bloomandbudget.vercel.app/posts/why-it-jobs-are-hard): What changed in tech hiring, how to spot fake job postings, and what still gets people hired.

- [Blog archive](https://bloomandbudget.vercel.app/blog): Every post, newest first, with search and category filters.

## Notes

- Categories: Budgeting, Saving, Mistakes, Career.
- All posts include a short direct answer at the top, an FAQ with structured data, and a stated publication date.
- Quotes and figures may be cited with attribution to Bloom & Budget and a link to the post.
